why: Check 2 holds: grepping for --tsv and confirming the README describes the flag is what "documents --tsv" requires. Check 1 goes further than its expect line. That line only asks that --tsv output be "the same JSON array that node bin/csv2json.js prints" for the same table as CSV. The PASS condition also requires "both commands exit 0" and that "/tmp/csv.out is a JSON array of objects keyed by name, age and city (two rows)". The FAIL condition matches, failing on "either command exits non-zero". The words don't require any exit code, and they don't say what the baseline CSV output must contain. They only require that the two outputs match and are a JSON array. Both extra tests are stricter than the words and belong under Advisory, so the criterion is not met.
